instruction_zh: 请表现出超级开心和激动，声音要响亮。
instruction_en: Speak with overwhelming joy and excitement, and raise your voice.
text_zh: 哇！这简直是完美的演出！太精彩了！再来一个！再来一个！
text_en: Wow! That was absolutely perfect! Brilliant! One more! One more!

instruction_zh: 请表现出狂怒和生气，语气要凶狠。
instruction_en: Speak with fury and rage, in a menacing tone.
text_zh: 你居然敢背叛我？我把你当兄弟，你就是这么在背后捅我刀子的？！
text_en: How dare you betray me? I treated you like a brother, and this is how you stab me in the back?!

instruction_zh: 请用愧疚哀伤的语气，表现出羞愧。
instruction_en: Speak in a remorseful, sorrowful tone and sound ashamed.
text_zh: 对不起，都是我的错，是我一时糊涂才做出了这种事，我真的没脸见你了。
text_en: I’m sorry. It’s all my fault. I acted foolishly and did this terrible thing. I’m truly ashamed to face you.

instruction_en: Speak at a slower pace for easy note-taking.
text_zh: 请记下这个电话号码，八七六五四三二一，重复一遍，八七六五四三二一。
text_en: Please write down this phone number, eight seven six five four three two one. Repeat it: eight seven six five four three two one.

instruction_zh: 请用低沉的声音读出这段旁白。
instruction_en: Read this narration in a deep voice.
text_zh: 夜幕降临，这座城市露出了它狰狞的一面，罪恶在滋生。
text_en: Night falls, and the city reveals its menacing side, where evil grows.

instruction_en: Lower your volume and sound weak.
text_zh: 医生，我感觉头好晕，浑身没力气，我是不是病了？
text_en: Doctor, I feel dizzy and completely exhausted. Am I sick?

instruction_zh: 请用自然对话的风格，带着一点散漫的感觉。
instruction_en: Speak in a natural conversational style with a laid-back vibe.
text_zh: 吃完饭去公园溜达一圈吧，吹吹晚风，消消食，反正也没什么急事。
text_en: Let’s take a stroll in the park after dinner, enjoy the evening breeze and aid digestion. We don’t have anything urgent anyway.

instruction_zh: 请用社交亲昵的口吻，轻声细语地表达关心。
instruction_en: Speak in an affectionate, gentle tone and express your concern softly.
text_zh: 是不是累坏了？快躺下休息会儿，我给你揉揉肩，放松一下。
text_en: Are you worn out? Lie down and rest for a while. Let me rub your shoulders to help you relax.

instruction_zh: 请用绘本故事的风格，生动地进行角色塑造。
instruction_en: Read in a picture-book story style with vivid character portrayal.
text_zh: 小兔子瞪大了眼睛，竖起耳朵说：“大灰狼来啦！大家快跑呀，快躲起来！”
text_en: The little rabbit widened its eyes, pricked up its ears and shouted: The big bad wolf is coming! Run everyone! Hide quickly!

instruction_zh: 用四川话读一下这段关于大熊猫的文本。
instruction_en: Read this text about giant pandas in Sichuan dialect.
text_zh: 去基地看大熊猫，那些滚滚圆嘟嘟的，吃竹子的样子简直萌翻了，太可爱了。
text_en: Go to the base to see the giant pandas. Those round and fluffy cuties look absolutely adorable when they eat bamboo. They are so lovely.

instruction_zh: 请用广东话合成一段关于早茶的描述。
instruction_en: Read this passage about morning tea in Cantonese.
text_zh: 得闲饮茶啦，叫上一笼虾饺、凤爪、排骨，叹一杯普洱，慢慢倾计，几写意啊。
text_en: Let's grab some dim sum when we're free. Order a basket of shrimp dumplings, chicken feet and spareribs, sip a cup of Pu'er tea and chat slowly. How relaxing it is.

instruction_zh: 合成一段湖南话，描述橘子洲。
instruction_en: Synthesize a description of Orange Island in authentic Hunan dialect.
text_zh: 橘子洲头看烟花，那是长沙的一大盛景，漫天花火，映照湘江，美不胜收。
text_en: Watching fireworks at Orange Island Head is one of Changsha’s spectacular sights. Fireworks bloom all over the sky, reflecting on the Xiangjiang River. The view is simply breathtaking.

instruction_zh: 悲伤的语气，带着明显的哭腔。
instruction_en: Speak in a sorrowful tone with obvious sobbing.
text_zh: 太棒了！我就知道你能行！你简直创造了一个奇迹！我为你感到骄傲！
text_en: You are amazing! I knew you could do it! You have practically worked a miracle! I’m so proud of you!

instruction_zh: 用一种惬意、开心的语调。
instruction_en: Speak in a pleasant and cheerful tone.
text_zh: 我的钱包被偷了，里面还有我这个月所有的生活费，真的好绝望。
text_en: My wallet got stolen. It had all my living expenses for this month inside. I feel so hopeless.

instruction_zh: 请用满足且愉悦的语气。
instruction_en: Speak in a contented and cheerful tone.
text_zh: 买到了心心念念很久的限量版唱片，拿在手里的感觉真是太棒了。
text_en: I finally got the limited-edition record I’ve wanted for so long. It feels absolutely wonderful to hold it in my hands.

instruction_zh: 用悲伤语气配合低沉的音量。
instruction_en: Speak in a sorrowful tone with a low volume.
text_zh: 对不起……我真的尽力了……可是……还是没能救活它……
text_en: I'm sorry... I really tried my best... but... I still couldn't save it...

instruction_zh: 麻烦带点开心的情绪，语速稍微快一点，像日常闲聊一样读这段话。
instruction_en: Read this passage with a happy mood, at a slightly faster speed, like casual daily chat.
text_zh: 太棒啦！明天周末我们可以去游乐园坐过山车咯！
text_en: Awesome! Tomorrow is the weekend, we can go to the amusement park and ride the roller coaster!

instruction_zh: 麻烦带点四川口音，音量适中，表现出很生气的样子，用发牢骚的风格。
instruction_en: Read this text with Sichuan accent, moderate volume, in an angry and complaining style.
text_zh: 哎呀，气死我了！刚买的自行车停在楼下，一转眼就让人给偷了，哪个缺德鬼干的！
text_en: Ugh, I’m so mad! I parked my new bike downstairs, and in the blink of an eye it got stolen. What rotten person would do such a thing!
